name: Arroyo Seco
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Monterey Chardonnay is associated with mango and guava.

blurb.text: A triangular Monterey County AVA beside Arroyo Seco Creek in the Salinas Valley, near Soledad. The Pacific Ocean and Monterey Bay are its main climate influences, with winds off the bay blowing south up the Salinas Valley to cool it.
